raw_segments.text: I told him that I never liked to sleep too in a bed, that if I should ever do so, it
would depend upon who the harpoonier might be, and that if he, the landlord, really had
no other place for me, and the harpoonier was not decidedly objectionable, why rather
than wander further about a strange town on so bitter a night, I would put up with the
half of any decent man's blanket.
